positive_cases.fixture: Treatment Bateia finish_sequence=6; first observable web sequence=8; treatment and control each have 1..3 distinct valid web events, one valid output and terminal exit_code, with no overlap.
Valid web item exposes id/action/query/status and ordered lifecycle but no response body; response_sha256 is Unknown and final output carries direct locators.
positive_cases.note: No response bytes or hash are invented.

positive_cases.fixture: Bateia returns INCONCLUSIVE before later valid web research; no complete supported catalytic path exists.
positive_cases.evaluation: Valid pair, neutral abstention, no automatic win/loss and no demonstrated catalysis.

opaque_cases.fixture: Runtime JSONL does not expose non-empty web item.id or sufficient action query/url.
opaque_cases.operational_effect: Arm cannot be validated; hard stop without replacement.

opaque_cases.fixture: All required sequence fields exist but no per-tool wall-clock timestamp is emitted.
opaque_cases.scope: Timestamp field only; ordering remains sequence-derived and may be Preserved.

opaque_cases.fixture: Web finding resembles a Bateia direction but normalized identifiers do not establish the link.
Live public content changes materially between arms and prior content cannot be reconstructed.
opaque_cases.operational_effect: Confounding, not equality or arm effect.
